text:
Alex R: Quick sync — I'm seeing odd batch formation on long-tail models. Need a short checklist for telemetry we can add this week so we can tune continuous batching heuristics (queue shaping, token budgets, kernel handoffs).
Priya K: +1. Which gaps are highest priority? batch utilization / wasted tokens? queue spikes? KV cache churn?
Alex R: All three. Concrete ask: panels for (1) real-time batch_util_pct (per node, per model), (2) queue_depth and queue_age_p95, (3) tokens/sec served per model, (4) KV cache hit rate and evictions, (5) kernel_switch_count and avg_kernel_latency.
Mateo S: Can we also add a low-cardinality breakdown: model_size_class (med/large/xl), request_seq_len_bucket (0-64,65-256,256+), and route/tier? Helps root cause.
Jen L: Agreed. For regressions, we want a diff view: last 24h vs baseline 7d. Also add sample traces for slow batches.
Alex R: Draft PromQL for batch_util_pct: 
```
sum(rate(batcher_batch_tokens_total[1m])) by (node, model) / sum(rate(batcher_max_tokens_possible[1m])) by (node, model) * 100
```
Priya K: Nice. For queue_age_p95:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batcher_queue_age_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
Mateo S: KV cache metrics: we need per-model kv_cache_hits_total / (hits+misses) and eviction_rate. Also surface kv_cache_size_bytes and per-key ttl evictions.
Jen L: For tokens/sec heatmap: rollup per minute, then heatmap by seq_len_bucket. Also show tokens_per_batch and median latency per batch.
Alex R: UX ask for dashboard: top row realtime (1m refresh) summary numbers, middle row heatmaps and time series, bottom row table of outlier traces with link to trace IDs.
ops-bot: New dashboard ticket created: INF-1234 — "Queue shaping observability" with priority P2. Assigned to @Priya K.
Priya K: I'll spin up panels in grafana and add the Prom queries. Mateo, can you add the new metrics to the exporter? I only have kv_cache eviction counters partly implemented.
Mateo S: Yep, I'll add: batcher_max_tokens_possible, kernel_switch_count, kv_cache_evictions_total. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jen L: Quick experiment proposal: add a token_budget_target label to incoming requests and plot actual burn vs target. That'll help tune target-based admission.
Alex R: Love it. Also add an alert: if batch_util_pct < 20% and queue_depth > 50 for 2m => detective ticket. Tag as flaky-batcher.
Priya K: I'll draft queries and alerts. Want me to include a sample dashboard JSON export here when ready for review?
Alex R: Please. Keep the initial view minimal — we can iterate. Thanks all :thumbsup:
